title: PAINT issue:Not active enzyme  CHPF2  IBA TO DELETE

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hello, thank you for the information. For the node in question (including also CPHF, as mentioned in PMID:41298522) I didn't just block the annotation, but created and propagated the negative annotation to link it ti the literature and ensure not to lose the information. I also created the annotation “Enzyme activator activity” from the same papers.
Best regards.
Marc

author: marcfeuermann
body: After discussion, I've replaced “Enzyme activator activity”  by "protein-macromolecule adaptor activity"

author: marcfeuermann
body:
I'm re-opening this one since I've requested the creation of a more appropriate MF: Protein-complex scaffolding activity.
I will re-annotate this family once the term is available for PAINTing.
I will also go through all the families annotated to "protein-macromolecule adaptor activity"  to see which have to be updated.

author: marcfeuermann
body: Finally the newly created terms are available for PAINTing. Done.
